text: «Ребенок сразу готов к тому, чтобы закончить первый класс, едва в него поступив»: почему детский сад не должен быть платформой подготовки к школе Сегодня глава Минпросвещения РФ Сергей Кравцов заявил, что детский сад не должен становиться подготовкой к школе. По его мнению, игровая деятельность у дошколят должна быть ведущей, так как развитие основных психологических функций происходит в возрасте до 7 лет. Практикующий детский психолог-педагог Дарья Дугенцова в разговоре с Readovka согласилась со словами Кравцова и подчеркнула, что для детей в подобном возрасте важно развивать психику с помощью сюжетно-ролевой игры. Без этого у ребенка дошкольного и младшего школьного возрастов могут возникнуть проблемы с мотивацией, обучением и саморегуляцией, что порой приводит к компенсации* через игровую зависимость. Игровая форма познания, по словам Дугенцовой, приносит детям настоящее удовольствие, а школа позволяет изучать мир через постижение знаний. Однако в детсадах не должны полностью отказываться от обучения — ребенок может учиться писать, считать до десяти и читать исключительно в игровой форме. Эксперт подчеркнула, что проблема баланса между детским садом и школой заключается в повыше
author: Readovka

text: Первый день голосования на выборах в Госдуму завершился — более 32,7 млн человек получили бюллетени В России завершился первый из трех дней голосования на выборах депутатов Госдумы IX созыва. По данным ЦИК, 18 сентября избирательные бюллетени получили 29,45% избирателей. На федеральной платформе ДЭГ проголосовали около 2,5 млн человек, что более 60% зарегистрировавшихся участников. Еще 2 млн москвичей воспользовались электронной системой голосования столицы. Что известно о голосовании в регионах на момент публикации: — Самая высокая доля получивших бюллетени по итогам первого дня зафиксирована в ДНР — около 80%, Брянской области — свыше 60%, Запорожской области — 59,7%, Херсонской области — 58,31% и Севастополе — 43,55%; — В приграничных регионах показатели тоже остаются высокими: в Белгородской области бюллетени получили 41,66% избирателей, в Курской — более 35%. В Белгородской области во время ракетной и беспилотной опасности комиссии и избиратели уходили в укрытия, после отбоя тревоги голосование возобновлялось; — В Москве в первый день бюллетени получили более 2 млн человек, что соответствует примерно 29,4% избирателей; в Санкт-Петербурге — более миллиона человек, или 27,01%; —

title: Airport malaria in Germany remains infrequent
text: Science Germany Airport malaria in Germany remains infrequent Julia Vergin 09/18/2026 September 18, 2026 An outbreak of malaria at Frankfurt Airport this summer has raised alarm. Experts believe parasites probably arrived in a passenger's luggage. But with the onset of fall, the risks of contracting the disease are low. https://p.dw.com/p/5MsNM Malaria is only transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes Image: James Gathany/AP Photo/dpa/picture alliance Advertisement Eight people are known to have contracted malaria in the vicinity of Frankfurt Airport in central Germany since July; three of them have died . Those affected are mostly employees of the airport operator Fraport. The Frankfurt Public Health Department believes the outbreak is due to "airport malaria," which occurs when a female Anopheles mosquito carrying the malaria parasite travels by aircraft to a country where the disease is not common from one where it is , bites a person and infects their red blood cells. title: Trump says CNN, MS Now and Politico are banned from White House, repeating familiar ‘fake news’ attacks – live
text: 15.19 EDT Trump says he has banned CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House In a new post to his personal social media platform, Donald Trump said that he would ban three news outlets – CNN, MS Now (formerly MSNBC) and Politico – from the White House. “Media Outlets shouldn’t be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they’re covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America,” the US president wrote. Trump threatened that other media outlets were soon to face the same punishment. What exactly prompted the president to ax those three outlets – beyond familiar allegations that they were “fake news” – was not immediately clear. Nor did he elaborate on which outlets he would consider targeting. It isn’t the first time Trump has tried to bar a news outlet whose coverage he found unfavorable from the White House. title: Attorneys for Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs drop music mogul, alleging unpaid legal bills

The musician, who is serving a 50-month federal prison term for prostitution-related offenses, has become increasingly belligerent in recent months, causing “a total breakdown in cooperation and communication” with New York law firm Sher Tremonte, one of its partners, Michael Tremonte, said in a court filing. По словам начальника штаба, после взятия Белогорья и Малой Токмачки у бойцов появился адреналин, действуют уверенно, а штурмовики хотят заходить уже дальше Орехова. Подробнее об обстановке на Запорожском направлении — в репортаже. Как наши войска берут в полуохват Орехов и как выдавили ВСУ из сложнейшего укрепа в Малой Токмачке — смотрите здесь и тут . #ВоенкорыRT 🟩 Подписаться на RT: ТГ | Зеркало | MAX

text: Разом із Президентом Румунії Нікушором Даном взяли участь у першому Карпатському економічному форумі. Окремо на ньому працює інвестиційна EXPO-зона, де кожна країна Карпатської вісімки презентує інвестиційні спроможності для регіону. Дев’ять українських компаній представляють свої проєкти в енергетиці, промисловості, транспорті й логістиці та агропродовольчому секторі. Після форуму разом із Нікушором Даном відвідали виставку. Це тільки початок, і у нас дійсно дуже хороші результати першого саміту. Велика кількість бізнесу залучена до цього результату. Вже на один мільярд є домовленості. Інвестиції в Українські Карпати мають серйозний запит. Наступний крок – це інвестиції в туризм.
author: President of Ukraine

text: Коли Ліндсі Грем був тут, в Україні, він завжди говорив, як важливо не збавляти тиск на Росію, посилювати санкції та шукати шлях до миру. Зокрема, й у тих столицях, де ухвалюють рішення про купівлю російської нафти, надання Росії фінансових послуг та залучення російських компаній, пов’язаних із Путіним та війною, до звичайних бізнесових відносин в інших країнах. Сенатор Грем ні на мить не сумнівався, що Америка має достатньо сили для боротьби з диктаторами та досягнення результатів, якщо діятиме ПРАВИЛЬНО. Дякую Президенту Трампу за підписання цього надважливого закону. Дякую всім сенаторам і членам Палати представників, які його підтримали. Найкращим вшануванням пам’яті Ліндсі буде повноцінна і якнайшвидша реалізація положень цього закону. А найкращою нагородою для всіх, хто допомагає нам тиснути на Росію заради закінчення війни, стане мир. Мир і зняття всіх проблем та викликів, які принесла ця війна. Мир настає завдяки силі. Спокій приходить завдяки безпеці. А найкращою гарантією безпеки є рішучість. Дякую всім, хто рішуче захищає життя! Дякую всім, хто з Україною! Америко, дякую!
author: President of Ukraine

text: «Пытались остановить наше продвижение, но мы им не позволили этого сделать» ▫️ На страницах газеты «Красный воин» вышла история о командире танка Т‐80БВ 12‐го гвардейского танкового полка группировки «Запад» с позывным «Сокол» . Он прошел путь от механика‐водителя до командира боевой машины. ➡️ За его плечами – десятки выполненных боевых задач. В один из таких выходов танк «Сокола» прикрывал штурмовиков. В какой-то момент обстановка изменилась, на направлении появился вражеский танк... 💥 Экипаж «Сокола» быстро сориентировался, занял огневую позицию и прямой наводкой поразил машину врага. «Вражеский танк полыхал. Наши парни смогли продолжить наступление. В такие моменты решение нужно принимать без промедления», – поделился танкист. Мужество и профессионализм молодого командира танка были высоко оценены командованием, «Сокол» отмечен двумя госнаградами – медалью «За отвагу» и знаком отличия ордена Святого Георгия – Георгиевским Крестом IV степени. #ИсторииСВОих 🔹 Курс на MAКС!
author: Russian Ministry of Defence

text: Президент США Дональд Трамп объявил о «немедленном» закрытии доступа в Белый дом для сотрудников телеканалов CNN и MS NOW (бывший MSNBC) и новостного сайта Politico и добавил, что в будущем запрет может коснуться и других журналистов. Пока неясно, как этот запрет будет работать. О запрете Трамп написал в длинном посте на сайте Truth Social, отметив, что перечисленные им СМИ «постоянно пишут и сообщают выдумки или ложь» о его администрации. Он не привел конкретных примеров. На последующей пресс-конференции в Белом доме президент сказал, что «никаких поводов» для этого заявления в пятницу не было. «За несколько лет накопилось достаточно подобных историй. Надоело», — сказал Трамп. Затронутые решением Трампа СМИ и организации по защите свободы слова с высокой вероятностью оспорят запрет в судах. 🔗 Подробнее по ссылке 🔗 Открыть без VPN | YouTube | Рассылка | Новое приложение BBC World Service
author: BBC Russian

text: ‼️ # Суми : росіяни завдали авіаційного удару — наразі відомо про 8 травмованих, з них 2 дітей, та 2 загиблих. Увечері ворожа авіація завдала удару по 9-поверховому житловому будинку, влучання відбулося між 3-м та 4-м поверхами. Рятувальникам вдалося деблокувати з-під завалів 4 людей, серед них — 7-річного хлопчика, та передати їх медикам швидкої. Також фахівці ДСНС дістали тіла двох загиблих — чоловіка та жінки. Виникло загоряння автомобілів, пожежу ліквідовано. Верхолази ДСНС розбирають завали. На місці події працювали психологи ДСНС. 🆘 Сайт • Fb • X • IG • YT • TT

title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. title: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand
text: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand Sep. 18, 2026 A production facility owned by the Transneft oil pipeline operator. REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. Chinese state-owned refiners rushed to lock in November and December ESPO cargoes early, although they typically purchase the grade one or two months in advance due to the short shipping distance. The buying spree pushed the ESPO grade’s price premium over benchmark ICE Brent to record levels of $20 to $30 per barrel. ESPO is a low-sulfur, light Siberian crude exported primarily via the Kozmino port in Russia's Far East. China primarily imports the unique blend, as well as Arctic and Sakhalin grades. The surge in premium costs comes as Iran and its proxies continue to retaliate against U.S. strikes and economic warfare. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. title: Kremlin Seizes Nestlé and Auchan Assets in Latest Business Crackdown
text: Kremlin Seizes Nestlé and Auchan Assets in Latest Business Crackdown By Reuters Sep. 18, 2026 A Nestlé factory in the Perm region. Master Snov (Public Domain) The Kremlin said on Friday that hostile actions by "unfriendly" countries played a role in its decision to take control of the Russia n assets of Swiss food giant Nestlé and French retailer Auchan. The move, announced in a decree signed by President Vladimir Putin, is the most significant action against Western firms since the seizure of the Russia n assets of French dairy company Danone and Danish brewer Carlsberg in 2023. "We are talking about European companies from unfriendly countries," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters, adding that these states were "currently involved in the most active manner in military actions against our country." Peskov did not name France or Switzerland specifically, but Russia says Western countries that supply weapons to Ukraine, including France, are effectively parties to the conflict. title: Where Can Russian Athletes Compete After the IOC’s Provisional Ban Lift?
text: Where Can Russian Athletes Compete After the IOC’s Provisional Ban Lift? By Ned Garvey Sep. 18, 2026 International Handball tournament "Friendship Cup 2026" in Moscow. Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Russia’s return to international sports competition was already well underway long before the International Olympic Committee (IOC) provisionally lifted its ban on the Russian and Belarusian Olympic Committees this July. The shift began in September 2025, when the International Paralympic Committee voted against maintaining its ban on Russian and Belarusian athletes, paving the way for them to compete at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Paralympic Games, where Russian competitors won eight gold medals. By December, the IOC recommended that international federations lift their bans on Russian and Belarusian youth athletes. However, some individual governing bodies acted even earlier. The International Judo Federation became the first to restore full participation rights to senior Russian athletes in November of last year. text: Drone Attacks Disrupt First Day of Voting in Southern Russia and Occupied Ukraine Sep. 18, 2026 A woman in the partially occupied Donetsk region of Ukraine casts a vote in the Russian parliamentary elections. title: Trump says US, Denmark reach deal to expand military presence in Greenland

text: Новый гуманитарный конвой КПРФ. Порядковый номер — 160 Из Совхоза имени Ленина отправили в Новороссию 160-й гуманитарный конвой . В формировании участвовали коммунисты, трудовые коллективы, наши сторонники. В зону СВО направлены дроны, мотоциклы, автомобили УАЗ, генераторы, автозапчасти, инструменты, продукты питания и ещё многое, что крайне необходимо. Гуманитарная миссия КПРФ позволит поддержать детские дома, школы, больницы и госпитали. Туда будут доставлены тёплая одежда, овощи, фрукты, сладости. Письма поддержки от ветеранов и школьников прибудут на передовую, чтобы согреть сердца бойцов. В момент отправки конвоя Председатель ЦК КПРФ Г.А. Зюганов подчеркнул: «Победа куётся в тылу. Когда одни сражаются за Родину, а другие на ней наживаются, победить невозможно. Всё острее стоит вопрос соответствия проводимого курса национальным интересам. Правящий класс от них оторван, а олигархические круги игнорируют стратегические задачи страны». Нынешняя политика государства не отвечает на вызовы времени. России крайне необходимы перемены. Их основой должно являться укрепление социальной справедливости, развитие производства и технологий, мобилизация сил на решение общенациональных задач. Ф
author: Boris Rozhin

text: ЕС не признал итоги выборов в Госдуму ещё за три дня до начала голосования. Евросоюз подготовил политическую реакцию на российские выборы задолго до открытия избирательных участков. text: Однако же появление у неприятеля богопротивных «хорнетов», что натворили немало бед, здорово дисциплинирует военнослужащего. Тут либо «не было бы счастья», либо «пока гром не грянет». Кому что больше по вкусу. Помимо того, что защитные очки стали наконец частью снаряжение бойца, а не «гы-гы, посмотри на этого рЕмбу», люди научились подгонять под себя и правильно носить бронежилеты. Все потому, что неправильно подогнанный жилет не только открывает то, что должен бы прикрыть, но и стремительно «убивает» позвоночник. Когда нужно долго-долго ехать стоя, наблюдая за небом, ты либо надеваешь его, как следует, либо уже через полчаса начинаешь корчиться от боли в пояснице. Даже штатный армейский броник, разобраться с которым способны лишь милитари-гики, теперь сидит на бойце, как влитой. Прям любо-дорого. Еще немного и неотъемлемой частью джентльменского набора станет страховочный трос на боевом поясе, чтобы гонять в кузове, не боясь вылететь на какой-нибудь особенно подлой выбоине. @harry_homolsky
author: Boris Rozhin

text: Март 2026 года. Район населенного пункта Х. Старший разведчик Бригады «Волки» «Димар» вместе со своим подразделением выполнял сложнейшую боевую задачу. Когда один из его близких друзей получил ранение, группа приняла решение оставаться на позициях, удерживая рубеж пять долгих суток. Но когда стало ясно, что оставаться дальше невозможно, Димар отдал приказ на эвакуацию. При отходе Димар подорвался на мине, потеряв обе ноги. Несмотря на страшные увечья, которые получили и другие бойцы, он не позволил панике взять верх. Димар продолжал выводить группу из-под огня. Когда силы окончательно иссякли, товарищи укрыли его в безопасном месте и вызвали эвакуационную группу. К несчастью, из-за тяжелой обстановки на ЛБС, помощь подоспела слишком поздно. Димар скончался от полученных ран, до последнего вздоха оставаясь верным присяге и своим братьям по оружию. У него остались жена и трое детей. Покойся с миром, брат. Ты навсегда останешься в строю. Быть воином - жить вечно 🙏 @ZParaBellumMD
author: Boris Rozhin

text: Эксклюзив «Военной хроники» : бойцы отряда «Шторм». Позывной Ногай. Часть 2 После первого тяжёлого ранения Ногай ещё не раз получал ранения. Врачи хотели комиссовать его по инвалидности. Он отказался и вернулся командовать штурмовой ротой — не смог оставить своих ребят. «Штурмовик не идёт умирать — он идёт работать», — говорит командир, – «Если я уйду, все уйдут, кто работать будет?» Отдельная история — эвакуация мирной жительницы, пожилой женщины из Нью-Йорка (Новгородского), у которой была мечта увидеть Москву. Ногай лично выводил ее 13 километров пешком, прикрывая собой от дронов. Признаётся: страшно не за себя, а за молодых бойцов. С болью вспоминает 18-летнего парня, погибшего в первом же бою — и убеждён, что таким мальчишкам на войне не место. Подробности — в видео. Начало истории Ногая – тут.
author: Boris Rozhin

text: Второй сезон нашего цикла фильмов «Тактическая медицина» объявляется открытым. И первый герой — инструктор по такмеду с позывным «Дада» , что в переводе с бенгальского означает «старший брат». Морской пехотинец, и, глядя на него, понимаешь — он истинный «чёрный берет». На фронте вместе с ним воюет его младший братишка. Каждый день «Дада» работает под постоянной угрозой: дроны противника охотятся за ним, за его машиной, за его бойцами. Его задача — вытаскивать раненых, когда вокруг слишком горячо. А в перерывах между выездами он учит других, как выжить самому и помочь товарищу. «Дада», как он сам говорит, «живёт, когда едет на задачу». Морпех расскажет, как тактическая медицина на самом деле спасает жизни. Покажет реальные кадры с фронта, атаки противника и невероятные спасения бойцов и гражданских. Всё это уже в нашей группе «Вконтакте» . 📱 Подписывайтесь на «Добро и Зло»

text: 📆 Еженедельная авторская колонка; ⚡️ Руководителя проекта «Курсы тактической медицины» с позывным «Латыш » ✅ Специально для канала Colonelcassad Коагуляция сосуда при минно-взрывной травме При минно-взрывной травме (МВТ) с отрывом или тяжелым повреждением конечности жгут накладывается обязательно , даже если видимого кровотечения в данный момент нет. Вот основные причины и нюансы: Почему нет крови? Термическая коагуляция: высокая температура взрывной волны может буквально «заварить» концы сосудов, временно запечатывая их. Вазоспазм: сильнейший болевой синдром и сама травма вызывают резкий спазм сосудов, который на время прекращает кровоток. Тромбоз: кровь может быстро свернуться в месте повреждения из-за массивного выброса факторов свертывания и повреждения тканей. Почему жгут всё равно нужен? Отсутствие крови — временное и обманчивое состояние. При восполнении объема циркулирующей крови, выходе из шока или просто при движении раненого «пробки» в сосудах могут вылететь, что приведет к массивному вторичному кровотечению , которое в полевых условиях часто становится фатальным. Правила наложения жгута или турникета при МВТ «Высоко и туго»: в «красной зоне» (под обстрелом) жгут наклады

title: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents
text: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents Image source, BBC News Ukraine Image caption, Daria left her apartment in Kyiv this summer after Russia's attacks on the city intensified By Diana Kuryshko and Victoria Kalimbet BBC News Ukrainian Published 1 hour ago For much of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Daria was not afraid of the shelling. Even on nights of heavy bombardment, the 27-year-old could sleep through the explosions in her apartment in Kyiv. Like many Ukrainians, she relied on the "two-wall rule": staying safe by keeping two walls between herself and the outside world. But this year that has changed. In recent months, Russia has scaled up the intensity and frequency of its attacks against the Ukrainian capital. In the first 10 days of July alone, the Russians launched dozens of ballistic missiles in three major attacks, killing nearly 60 civilians, according to official figures. Similar large scale attacks took place in August and September. Грэма о санкциях против России и Ирана 2026 года“, который утверждает и расширяет предусмотренные законом санкции, пошлины и запреты в отношении России, а также продлевает действие существующих санкций против Ирана», — говорится на сайте Белого дома. Master Snov (Public Domain) The Kremlin said on Friday that hostile actions by "unfriendly" countries played a role in its decision to take control of the Russia n assets of Swiss food giant Nestlé and French retailer Auchan. The move, announced in a decree signed by President Vladimir Putin, is the most significant action against Western firms since the seizure of the Russia n assets of French dairy company Danone and Danish brewer Carlsberg in 2023. "We are talking about European companies from unfriendly countries," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters, adding that these states were "currently involved in the most active manner in military actions against our country." Peskov did not name France or Switzerland specifically, but Russia says Western countries that supply weapons to Ukraine, including France, are effectively parties to the conflict. Photograph: Google Maps Tennessee US woman falsely charged with bank theft sues for $10m over AI facial recognition Angela Lipps, 50, alleges in suit that Fargo police wrongly relied on AI facial recognition to arrest and charge her Lucy Campbell Fri 18 Sep 2026 19.34 EDT Last modified on Fri 18 Sep 2026 20.29 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A Tennessee woman who was falsely charged with bank theft in North Dakota and jailed for six months has sued for $10m in damages, alleging in a federal lawsuit that Fargo police improperly relied on an artificial intelligence (AI) facial recognition system to wrongly accuse her. Angela Lipps, 50, was arrested at gunpoint by US marshals at her home in Tennessee while babysitting her neighbor’s four children in July 2025. The mother of three and grandmother of five was booked into a county jail and remained there for almost four months without bail while awaiting extradition to North Dakota , where she was held for about two more months. title: Trump administration pushes on with construction of controversial Big Bend border wall
text: In this photo provided by Scott McWilliams, crews install the first sections of a new border wall in the Big Bend region of west Texas, on 16 September. Photograph: Scott McWilliams/AP View image in fullscreen In this photo provided by Scott McWilliams, crews install the first sections of a new border wall in the Big Bend region of west Texas, on 16 September. Photograph: Scott McWilliams/AP Texas Trump administration pushes on with construction of controversial Big Bend border wall Customs and Border Protection faces bipartisan backlash from locals for 30ft border wall through Texas national park Roque Planas Fri 18 Sep 2026 19.07 EDT Last modified on Fri 18 Sep 2026 19.08 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google The Trump administration is pressing forward with construction on the controversial border wall in the Big Bend region of west Texas , even as Customs and Border Protection (CBP) faces furious backlash from local leaders and landowners for its fast-moving plans. Construction began this week in Hudspeth county, which lies just east of the city of El Paso. CBP has been pressing landowners there to grant permission to allow the agency to erect a 30ft steel bollard border wall
author: Roque Planas

text: "Я хочу жить, как жил до всего этого! Я и в Крым ездил , в Россию и пи***сов не было!" Продолжаем историю военнослужащего 127 отмбр Тимченко Николая Ивановича (15.05.1981 г.р.), взятого в плен в Харьковской области. В предыдущей части он рассказал о своем пути на позиции и условиях нахождения там. О проблемах со снабжением и голоде. Само собой в таких условиях единственным правильным решением оказалось сдача в плен. Сегодня мы проведем небольшое информирование с пленным военнослужащим и доведем до него несколько украинских новостей. Это должен был делать замполит роты, но тот самоустранился от выполнения своих обязанностей, оставив своих подчиненных в неведении относительно ситуации в стране. Также покажем ему несколько видеороликов из его родного города Харькова. Потом выслушаем его мнение по поводу всего происходящего. @warriorofnorth
author: Boris Rozhin

text: "Аэрофлот" и структуры "Ростеха" заключили контракт на поставку и послепродажное обслуживание 90 самолетов МС-21, передает "Интерфакс". По условиям сделки авиакомпания получит самолеты с 2029 по 2032 год: 14 единиц - в 2029 г., 18 - в 2030-м, 24 - в 2031-м и 34 - в 2032-м. Контракт также предусматривает поставку авиатренажеров, услуг по подготовке летного состава, послепродажное обслуживание на срок 22 года, говорится в совместном пресс-релизе компаний. Со стороны "Ростеха" документ подписали ПАО "Объединенная авиастроительная корпорация" (ОАК), лизинговая компания "Авиакапитал-Сервис" и "Объединенная двигателестроительная корпорация" (ОДК). Производство каждого самолета занимает от полутора до двух лет, контракт с "Аэрофлотом" обеспечивает "понятную загрузку на годы вперед и создает основу для планомерного наращивания серийного производства", отметил глава "Ростеха" Сергей Чемезов. Глава ОАК Вадим Бадеха в свою очередь заявил о планах выстроить с "Аэрофлотом" стратегическое партнерство по "эффективному вводу в эксплуатацию нового воздушного судна". Техобслуживание МС-21, которые получит "Аэрофлот", будет закреплено за ОАК, пояснял ранее гендиректор авиакомпании Сергей Александровс
author: Boris Rozhin

title: Sensitive UK police data vulnerable to ‘compromise’ by US government and foreign actors
text: Illustration: Guardian Design/Getty View image in fullscreen Illustration: Guardian Design/Getty Police Sensitive UK police data vulnerable to ‘compromise’ by US government and foreign actors Exclusive: Official UK security assessment found Microsoft cloud platform storing files was at potential risk from hostile hackers Aisha Down Fri 18 Sep 2026 13.00 EDT Last modified on Sat 19 Sep 2026 00.12 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Vast troves of highly sensitive police data are lying on Microsoft cloud platforms which an oﬃcial UK security assessment deemed to be vulnerable to “compromise” by foreign actors and the US government, a Guardian investigation can reveal. The files include criminal records, victim statements, internal emails and sensitive information held by more than 40 police forces across the UK. Some files exceed “oﬃcial” classification, according to a police document seen by the Guardian, raising the possibility the information could be classed as “secret” or “top secret”. author: Aisha Down

title: Police move hundreds of migrants still in Ceuta off beaches in Spanish enclave
text: Advertising Police move hundreds of migrants still in Ceuta off beaches in Spanish enclave Europe Spanish police in Ceuta on Friday morning started moving hundreds of migrants from the beaches of the Spanish enclave to a new tented area. Several thousand migrants remain in Ceuta after tens of thousands of people crossed the border with Morocco in late July. Issued on: 18/09/2026 - 11:51 1 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 This picture shows large tents at the new Los Rosales migrant reception camp, where more than 800 people have been transferred from the Loma Colmenar camp, in Ceuta, on September 12, 2026. © Antonio Sempere, AFP Police on Friday began moving hundreds of migrants from the beaches of Ceuta to the Spanish enclave's port area. During the transfer, the police struggled to contain crowds of people jostling to secure a spot at the new tented site after weeks of living on the beaches. Authorities say there are enough tents for 1,700 people. Read more The Ceuta effect: how far will Europe's anti-migrant backlash go? text: В Сумах два человека погибли при российском бомбовом ударе — местные власти Сумская областная администрация сообщает, что при российском ударе планирующими бомбами по городу вечером пятницы погибли два человека. Ранены, по данным на этот момент, семь человек, в том числе 13-летняя девочка. Трое из раненых, как сообщает администрация, находятся в тяжелом состоянии. Об ударе КАБами по окраинам Сум и разрушениях в многоэтажных жилых домах ранее сообщали Сумская областная и городская военная администрации, некоторое время назад мэр Сум Артем Кобзарь писал в соцсетях о пяти раненых. Об ударе по Сумам написал в соцсетях и президент Украины Владимир Зеленский. 💬 Было прямое попадание бомбы между третьим и четвертым этажом [жилой девятиэтажки]. Из-под завалов уже спасли четырех человек, в том числе и ребенка. По состоянию на сейчас известно, что, к сожалению, два человека погибли […] Под завалами еще могут быть люди. Спасатели делают все, чтобы деблокировать их и потушить пожары 💬 , — гласит запись в телеграм-канале Зеленского. 💬 Именно про необходимость остановить такие жестокие удары по жизни каждый день говорит Украина, — продолжил украинский президент. — Буквально сейчас у Америки есть
author: BBC Russian

text: Президент США Дональд Трамп объявил о «немедленном» закрытии доступа в Белый дом для сотрудников телеканалов CNN и MS NOW (бывший MSNBC) и новостного сайта Politico и добавил, что в будущем запрет может коснуться и других журналистов. Пока неясно, как этот запрет будет работать. О запрете Трамп написал в длинном посте на сайте Truth Social, отметив, что перечисленные им СМИ «постоянно пишут и сообщают выдумки или ложь» о его администрации. Он не привел конкретных примеров. На последующей пресс-конференции в Белом доме президент сказал, что «никаких поводов» для этого заявления в пятницу не было. 💬 За несколько лет накопилось достаточно подобных историй. Надоело 💬 , — сказал Трамп. Затронутые решением Трампа СМИ и организации по защите свободы слова с высокой вероятностью оспорят запрет в судах. 🔗 Подробнее по ссылке 🔗 Открыть без VPN | YouTube | Рассылка | Новое приложение BBC World Service
author: BBC Russian

text: Трамп подписал закон об «адских санкциях» против России Президент США Дональд Трамп в пятницу подписал закон, позволяющий ввести расширенные санкции против России, говорится в заявлении Белого дома. «Адские санкции» продвигал сенатор-республиканец Линдси Грэм, умерший в июле. В августе американский Сенат подавляющим большинством голосов (86 против 11) утвердил закон об «адских санкциях» против России за украинскую войну, а на этой неделе документ утвердила Палата представителей, после чего документ был отправлен на подпись президенту Трампу. 💬 В пятницу, 18 сентября 2026 года, президент подписал и ввел в силу законопроект H.R. 5334 — „Закон Линдси О. Грэма о санкциях против России и Ирана 2026 года“, который утверждает и расширяет предусмотренные законом санкции, пошлины и запреты в отношении России, а также продлевает действие существующих санкций против Ирана 💬 , — говорится на сайте Белого дома. Закон закрепляет уже введенные президентскими указами санкции США против России, в том числе ограничительные меры в отношении российского «теневого флота» и санкции против российских чиновников и бизнесменов, поддерживающих российский ВПК. title: Trump signs Graham sanctions bill targeting Russia
text: Trump signs Graham sanctions bill targeting Russia Iryna Vakuliuk — 19 September, 01:00 Donald Trump. Photo: Getty Images Посилання скопійовано Add UP as preferred source in Google US President Donald Trump has signed a bill on sanctions against Russia, co-authored by the late Senator Lindsey Graham. Source: White House Quote: "HH.R. 5334, the 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026,' which authorises and expands statutory sanctions, tariffs, and prohibitions on Russia and extends existing sanctions on Iran." Advertisement: Details: Trump signed the bill on 18 September (in Kyiv time, on the night of 18-19 September). The law has therefore now entered into force. The legislation provides for sanctions against Russian officials, banks, oligarchs and the shadow fleet and allows the US president to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries that buy Russian oil and gas. Sanctions against Iran are extended for another five years. Background: On 17 September, the US House of Representatives passed a bill on sanctions against Russia backed by the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham. title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand
text: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand Sep. 18, 2026 A production facility owned by the Transneft oil pipeline operator. REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. Chinese state-owned refiners rushed to lock in November and December ESPO cargoes early, although they typically purchase the grade one or two months in advance due to the short shipping distance. The buying spree pushed the ESPO grade’s price premium over benchmark ICE Brent to record levels of $20 to $30 per barrel. ESPO is a low-sulfur, light Siberian crude exported primarily via the Kozmino port in Russia's Far East. China primarily imports the unique blend, as well as Arctic and Sakhalin grades. The surge in premium costs comes as Iran and its proxies continue to retaliate against U.S. strikes and economic warfare. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro

title: Ukrainian drones damage homes in Russia’s Rostov region. Moscow mayor says 350 drones were headed for the capital.
text: More than 50 Ukrainian drones were shot down overnight over Russia’s Rostov region during an attack on September 18, Rostov Governor Yuri Slyusar said. According to Slyusar, no one was injured. In Azov, the attack damaged five private homes and several vehicles. In the Neklinovsky district, it damaged the roofs and windows of eight apartment buildings. The Ukrainian Telegram channel Supernova+ reported that an air base in Rostov-on-Don was also attacked, a claim Russian authorities have not confirmed. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said more than 350 drones headed toward the Moscow region starting on the evening of September 17, and most were destroyed “at long range.” Air defenses shot down 64 more as they approached the Russian capital. Sobyanin did not disclose the aftermath of the attack. On September 17, Rostov-on-Don came under a massive attack by Ukrainian drones. Part of the city was left without electricity. Telegram channels reported a fire at the “Rostov-on-Don — Tsentralny” military airfield, in the area where helicopters and planes are stationed. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed that an An-12 plane, two An-26 planes, and three helicopters were damaged. Russ

text: Russian guided bombs hit apartment building in northeastern Ukraine, killing two city council employees September 18, 2026, 10:19 pm Source: Oleh Hryhorov Russian forces struck a multistory apartment building in Sumy with guided aerial bombs, killing two people, Oleh Hryhorov, the head of the Sumy regional administration, said. title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand
text: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand Sep. 18, 2026 A production facility owned by the Transneft oil pipeline operator. REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. Chinese state-owned refiners rushed to lock in November and December ESPO cargoes early, although they typically purchase the grade one or two months in advance due to the short shipping distance. The buying spree pushed the ESPO grade’s price premium over benchmark ICE Brent to record levels of $20 to $30 per barrel. ESPO is a low-sulfur, light Siberian crude exported primarily via the Kozmino port in Russia's Far East. China primarily imports the unique blend, as well as Arctic and Sakhalin grades. The surge in premium costs comes as Iran and its proxies continue to retaliate against U.S. strikes and economic warfare. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro

title: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents
text: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents Image source, BBC News Ukraine Image caption, Daria left her apartment in Kyiv this summer after Russia's attacks on the city intensified By Diana Kuryshko and Victoria Kalimbet BBC News Ukrainian Published 19 September 2026 For much of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Daria was not afraid of the shelling. Even on nights of heavy bombardment, the 27-year-old could sleep through the explosions in her apartment in Kyiv. Like many Ukrainians, she relied on the "two-wall rule": staying safe by keeping two walls between herself and the outside world. But this year that has changed. In recent months, Russia has scaled up the intensity and frequency of its attacks against the Ukrainian capital. In the first 10 days of July alone, the Russians launched dozens of ballistic missiles in three major attacks, killing nearly 60 civilians, according to official figures. Similar large scale attacks took place in August and September. A BBC Verify analysis of government figures found Kyiv is now suffering more daily air raid alerts than at any time since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022. I

title: Zelensky announces new ‘Carpathian Eight.’ Tusk and Vučić attend its first summit (but Fico doesn’t)
text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced a new international cooperation initiative, the “Carpathian Eight”: We are launching a new format — “C8,” the Carpathian Eight — bringing together us and our neighbors in Europe: Romania, Serbia, Poland, Slovakia, Czechia, Austria, Hungary, and, of course, the European Union as a whole. Zelensky said the new format aims to unite the states, regions, and local communities of the Carpathian region, with participants planning to cooperate on security, energy, logistics, and cross-border economic matters. The first summit of the “Carpathian Eight” began on September 18 in Ukraine’s Ivano-Frankivsk region, with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić, and Romanian President Nicușor Dan taking part. Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico, who had said a day earlier that he planned to visit Ukraine, skipped the summit. title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand
text: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand Sep. 18, 2026 A production facility owned by the Transneft oil pipeline operator. REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. Chinese state-owned refiners rushed to lock in November and December ESPO cargoes early, although they typically purchase the grade one or two months in advance due to the short shipping distance. The buying spree pushed the ESPO grade’s price premium over benchmark ICE Brent to record levels of $20 to $30 per barrel. ESPO is a low-sulfur, light Siberian crude exported primarily via the Kozmino port in Russia's Far East. China primarily imports the unique blend, as well as Arctic and Sakhalin grades. The surge in premium costs comes as Iran and its proxies continue to retaliate against U.S. strikes and economic warfare. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro

title: Kremlin Seizes Nestlé and Auchan Assets in Latest Business Crackdown
text: Kremlin Seizes Nestlé and Auchan Assets in Latest Business Crackdown By Reuters Sep. 18, 2026 A Nestlé factory in the Perm region. Master Snov (Public Domain) The Kremlin said on Friday that hostile actions by "unfriendly" countries played a role in its decision to take control of the Russia n assets of Swiss food giant Nestlé and French retailer Auchan. The move, announced in a decree signed by President Vladimir Putin, is the most significant action against Western firms since the seizure of the Russia n assets of French dairy company Danone and Danish brewer Carlsberg in 2023. "We are talking about European companies from unfriendly countries," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters, adding that these states were "currently involved in the most active manner in military actions against our country." Peskov did not name France or Switzerland specifically, but Russia says Western countries that supply weapons to Ukraine, including France, are effectively parties to the conflict. title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
text: The Hotel Bamy in Malabo, where migrants are being held. Photograph: Monika Pronczuk/AP View image in fullscreen The Hotel Bamy in Malabo, where migrants are being held. Photograph: Monika Pronczuk/AP US immigration Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence Maanvi Singh Fri 18 Sep 2026 19.08 EDT First published on Fri 18 Sep 2026 17.59 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers. The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. text: Advertising Police move hundreds of migrants still in Ceuta off beaches in Spanish enclave Europe Spanish police in Ceuta on Friday morning started moving hundreds of migrants from the beaches of the Spanish enclave to a new tented area. Several thousand migrants remain in Ceuta after tens of thousands of people crossed the border with Morocco in late July. Issued on: 18/09/2026 - 11:51 1 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 This picture shows large tents at the new Los Rosales migrant reception camp, where more than 800 people have been transferred from the Loma Colmenar camp, in Ceuta, on September 12, 2026. © Antonio Sempere, AFP Police on Friday began moving hundreds of migrants from the beaches of Ceuta to the Spanish enclave's port area. title: Russia votes in parliamentary election as war in Ukraine drags on
text: Advertising Russia votes in parliamentary election as war in Ukraine drags on Europe Polls opened in Russia's Far East on Friday as the country began three days of voting for its parliamentary election, the first since Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The Kremlin's main party, United Russia, is poised to keep its grip on power alongside other parties aligned with President Vladimir Putin, as the only party that criticised the war was removed from the ballot. Issued on: 18/09/2026 - 07:38 Modified: 18/09/2026 - 08:18 6 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 A voter casts a ballot in the parliamentary election in Moscow, Russia, on September 18, 2026. © Alexander Zemlianichenk, AP It's a challenging time for Russia to hold a parliamentary election, even one whose outcome is all but assured. The economic and political climate has been seriously affected by 4 and a half years of full-fledged war with Ukraine . Swarms of enemy drones have inflicted massive damage on Russian oil refineries and logistical facilities. The public, which no longer sees the fighting as something distant, is increasingly nervous. title: Russia’s State Duma elections begin with record online turnout, a million votes in occupied Donetsk, and attempts to bribe observers
text: news Russia’s State Duma elections begin with record online turnout, a million votes in occupied Donetsk, and attempts to bribe observers September 18, 2026, 3:02 pm Source: Meduza Electronic voting machines in Moscow. On the first day of the State Duma election, they began breaking down en masse. Mikhail Metzel / TASS / ZUMA Press / Scanpix / LETA Access to Gosuslugi — the government services website voters need to log in through to cast an online ballot — stopped working from abroad. The outages began several days before voting started. By noon in Moscow, the number of people who had voted online was 100 times (!) higher than in the 2021 State Duma election. Meanwhile, polling stations had recorded zero turnout as of noon. Some Moscow residents who want to vote in person aren’t always given a ballot, while others refuse one themselves, insisting it “has to be done electronically.” Virtual queues built up in Moscow’s online voting system amid the surge in activity. The Moscow City Election Commission stated the backlog stemmed from attacks on the system, not pressure on people to vote. Putin voted, too. title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro

title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro

title: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin
text: On TikTok, Russia's Political Parties Court Voters Who Grew Up Under Putin By Angelina Trefilova Sep. 18, 2026 Alexander Berkutov. Alexander Berkutov / VK "Bandit on top of a bandit, thief on top of a thief!" teenager Alexander Berkutov says in a TikTok video, quoting the late ultranationalist politician Vladimir Zhirinovsky. Standing before a green screen, Berkutov imitates Zhirinovsky’s eccentric, bombastic delivery as he rails against corruption and the everyday problems facing “ordinary people,” including closed public restrooms in his hometown. Berkutov’s account is part of the online presence of the youth wing of Zhirinovsky’s right-wing populist Liberal Democratic Party (LDPR). Ahead of Russia’s Sept. 18-20 State Duma elections, youth wings affiliated with the country’s major political parties have ramped up their social media presence as they compete for voters who have grown up under President Vladimir Putin. Their videos adopt the memes, slang and anti-establishment style popular among young Russians. Yet the political choices they offer are soundly within the Kremlin’s limits, even as younger Russians show greater support than older generations for peace talks with Ukrai

title: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand
text: Russian Far East Crude Tops $120 Per Barrel as Middle East Supply Shocks Drive Chinese Demand Sep. 18, 2026 A production facility owned by the Transneft oil pipeline operator. REUTERS / Maxim Shemetov Prices for Russia’s ESPO blend of crude oil bound for China surged past $120 per barrel this week, Reuters reported Friday, citing trading sources and market data. Chinese state-owned refiners rushed to lock in November and December ESPO cargoes early, although they typically purchase the grade one or two months in advance due to the short shipping distance. The buying spree pushed the ESPO grade’s price premium over benchmark ICE Brent to record levels of $20 to $30 per barrel. ESPO is a low-sulfur, light Siberian crude exported primarily via the Kozmino port in Russia's Far East. China primarily imports the unique blend, as well as Arctic and Sakhalin grades. The surge in premium costs comes as Iran and its proxies continue to retaliate against U.S. strikes and economic warfare. title: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks
text: Wine Production in Crimea Drops 25% Amid Fuel Shortages and Supply Line Attacks Sep. 18, 2026 Vasily Kuzmichenok / Moskva News Agency Wine production in annexed Crimea fell by one-quarter in the first eight months of 2026 due to fuel shortages and logistical bottlenecks triggered by intensifying Ukrainian attacks , the newspaper Kommersant reported Friday. Data from Russia’s Federal Alcohol Market Regulation Service show Crimean still wine output dropped 24.7% year-on-year between January and August, while sparkling wine production fell 38%. In Russia, still wine output fell nearly 15% and sparkling wine dropped 14.5% over the same period. Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014, is a major regional supplier, accounting for 20% of all still wine and 10% of sparkling wine sold in Russia. Industry experts told Kommersant that the production slump was due to Ukraine ramping up its attacks on the peninsula this summer, triggering an acute fuel shortage and disrupting shipping between Crimea and the Russian mainland. Transporting essential production materials — including glass bottles, corks and packaging — has become increasingly expensive and hazardous, the experts said. Ro
